title: Separate ternary obstructions from bounded dyadic quotient tests
body:
## Summary

```text
For any prescribed finite dyadic range, an exact eight-call family:
  passes every rational rank cut and determinant equality
  realizes each covered quotient endpoint in H/(4^s H)
  fails a ternary character cut: 1 paid call < 3 target roles
```

Adds `research/bit-ternary-character-separation/`, with a written proof, exact lattice certificate and independent replay. The ternary rejection covers every call order and any finite number of restored dirty scalar roles. One fixed diagonal word realizes the covered quotients; it cannot realize the full formal endpoint.

This takes the unequal-class pre-search handoff from pending #2938, pinned at `050aa9f623d180a08b36a375c30004d060d480d5`. Its implementation and theorem are not dependencies. Projection/rank and cyclic-quotient methods are inherited; the contribution is this explicit separating family. Credit Ali Romman, Tuafo and the retained eumemic/PR288, huxint/PR203, compression, parity, cyclic-root and faithful-address lineage. Exact pins and credit are in SOURCES.json/README.md.

Task `bit-new-register-model`, priority revision 5, scope explicitly changed from a new alphabet to this screening implication. Scientific base `95ff4e2dd396c505932a43ff7c1cdfdd94b8c867`; refreshed main `3aa52a3b2f8c08994978f97d98c62cfa8e4916fb` changes archive policy but no priority, selected result, pinned input or replay control. The exact patch applies to refreshed main. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2898#discussioncomment-18974717).

## Evidence

- **Before:** the fixed s=1 candidate passes all rational cuts, determinant equality, all 64 binary characters and all 4,096 order-four counting cuts. Every one of its 28 six-frame minors is nonzero. Target determinants are 5184, 576 and 25524.
- **After:** X11 modulo three retains one paid frame and all three targets, excluding the full formal identity. All 729 ternary characters are checked; exactly two violate, each with margin -2. The written common-lattice and exponent-sum argument proves the scaling/quotient statement for every s, separately from the 16 finite formula controls.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay, optimized CPython 3.14.8 replay, seven behavioral groups, four actual implementation mutants, independent minor/image-code/F4 oracles, Ruff and warning-as-error compilation pass. Committed-byte preflight passes for `72d3e355f925677a2a2880dbd0e5432bf2a54d68`. Independent internal proof/code/source review found no blockers.
- Relevant workflow tests: 137 passed; seven Linux /proc tests skipped on macOS. Hosted CI is separate.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-ternary-character-separation
python3.12 -I -O -B research/bit-ternary-character-separation/verify.py
```

This rejects the stated family, not all mixed targets or every stronger cyclic obstruction. No independent human/formal review, native realization, hosting, precision/tape, full supplier cold replay or completed supplier moment is claimed. No new kappa or selected-frontier change. The next question is a concrete candidate passing these necessary screens before bounded scalar search and a complete native consumer bill.

## Merge danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast radius:** research.

One new opt-in package. Existing supplier, selected result, frozen evidence and shared runner files are unchanged.
